title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 42. Stresses that Türkiye’s intention to become a member of BRICS+, where it was offered ‘partner country’ status, and potentially the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), where it holds the status of a dialogue partner, is an expression of its national sovereignty, which must be respected; welcomes the fact that Türkiye has been cultivating cooperation formats, partnerships and regional alliances beyond the EU;
